dct_description_sm: The Circumpolar Health Bibliographic Database (CHBD) describes publications about all aspects of human health in the circumpolar region. The database is a project of the Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR) Team in Circumpolar Health Research. The CHBD describes publications about public health, medicine and human biology. All types of publications, both peer-reviewed and grey literature, are included.
